params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P3
Summary: Most trends show "Easing" because the first month of measurement counts as the baseline and the current month is still incomplete.

Backlog item from the brief: not for this pass. Recalculate the direction without the first month of measurement (March) and without the month that is still running, so a trend is not called easing for an artefact of the window.

Source: Portal mail:47 (copy update brief for gentells.com, 10 November 2026). The brief itself stays in Portal.
params.title: Trend direction: leave out the start-up month and the running month
